Update: Service appears to be gradually recovering after about half an hour, with some users able to use it again. Actual conditions may vary.

It is not just you who is affected. Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, and Grok are currently experiencing what appears to be a large-scale outage, affecting a large number of users.

While the outage is occurring, OpenAI is building hype for the release of GPT-6 Astra.

The issue is affecting the web, mobile, and desktop versions of ChatGPT. Claude appears to be experiencing the same outage. SpaceXAI has also confirmed that Grok is facing service abnormalities.

During this service outage, OpenAI may reportedly announce news about its next-generation large model, Astra, today. The new model may upgrade OpenAI's models from GPT-5.6 to GPT-6.

We will update our report if there is further news.
